item.title: About
item.description: V This is a small place on the internet I created for myself to write. I consider myself and embedded software engineer, with interest in music, coding, cryptography and nature. My primary goal is to write techincal articles about things I have learnt. I want to write about things the way I percieved them. The idea is to make it as simple and as short as possible for everyone on the internet.

item.title: Syncing This Blog Straight From a Private Git Repo
item.description: Why this blog is a folder of markdown files and a push, not a CMS login.

A Utopian city insipired by Circuits I was recently in New York. What an amazing city! I was walking on the streets of Manhattan, and I realized how efficient the city is. I was stunned by architecure, the busy vibe and ofcourse, all the beautiful women. Note that I call the city efficeint. Its a strange way to describe a city. Infact, it almost felt like the city has life. One quick walk from the central park to the Macys store made me realize that cities do have life.
